description: On the tabletop in front of you are a green plate near the back, a yellow pencil-like stick, a white earbud case, a purple square frame, and a couple of small clear and gray pieces. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips the yellow stick as a right-hand object, lifts it and moves it up toward the green plate, then sets it down on the plate and releases, while the left hand stays near the center without touching anything.
